issues.detail: Public wrapper delegates to absent manager method; existing controller uses experiment.get_status().
wait_for_experiment_completion returns True for FAILED; inspect state separately.
Decoder retains later complete frames; link decodes once per TCP recv, so a final frame may remain pending.
Decoded chart preserves values but optional path/qubit/step presence is reduced to default strings; pre-handler capture is not full wire capture.
Repeated chart_name overwrites prior points in SDK result; pre-handler recording required.
Queue update dereferences current_experiment without a null check.
Pulse becomes width/am/phase/freshift and is split by path into hPulse/pPulse; cross-channel timing is not specified.
Gradient voltage/duration serialize as value/delay; no live gradient write is authorized.
set_device_params updates the local wrapper and observers; this is not a hardware calibration write.
Missing received fields become zero in SDK cache/getters; auditor preserves original field presence.
device_id is generated by the client, not a confirmed hardware serial number.
SDK sample calibration handler only passes; pre-handler capture retains received fields.
Field declares step=10000; whether installed Pydantic enforces it on assignment remains unverified here.
SDK labels relaxation_delay in µs and sends it as relaxation_time, while prior local script used 15 from an example; exact behavior requires confirmation.
